what: On hover, the first layer (accent color) fills from the bottom in .5s, and the second layer (dark ink) covers it .1s later. On release the second layer leaves first and the first follows .1s later, so a band of color sweeps past once. The text rolls up one line in .4s while the same text rises from below 50ms later, and the round arrow exits to the right in .7s while a new arrow enters from the left .1s later. All curves are cubic-bezier(.65,.05,.36,1).

options.look: If ‹plain›, only letter roll and arrow with no mask (arrow next to an underlined link)

use: Get in Touch — Curtain colors are set with the --lw-a and --lw-b variables

from.where: shared.css .k-btn (light, dark and blue buttons — first layer blue, second layer blue-gray and ink)
